title: LND-R5-01: newer reply text lost on send acknowledgement
description: Independent recheck of PR #4 (candidate 646a72f). The support draft controller clears the reply box and the autosave timer in markSent() without checking which revision was sent, so text typed while the message POST is in flight is destroyed. Tie the send to the revision of the captured message text: only the sent revision may be cleared, newer edits stay in the box and survive a reload.
acceptance_criteria: Delayed POST: sending A and typing B during the wait sends only A, B remains in the box and is restored after reload. Repeat with an autosave PUT and a thread switch during the wait: the stale acknowledgement neither erases the new edit nor changes the selected thread.
notes: LND-R5-01 fixed in apps/web/src/workspaces/support-draft-autosave.ts + SupportClaimsWorkspace.tsx. The controller tracks a revision of the reply box (every setBody raises it) and markSent(threadId, sentRevision) only clears the box when the sent revision is still the current one; a newer edit stays in the box, keeps its autosave timer and is saved (the newer text replaces the sent answer on the server). The workspace captures the revision of the payload it sends and passes it to markSent; it never issues a raw DELETE on the draft any more. markSent never touches the selected thread. Tests: test/web/support-draft-autosave.test.ts (new describe block, 7 cases).

title: LND-R4-01 P1: server draft is deleted by autosave while it is still loading
description: PR #4 audit LND-R4-01. SupportClaimsWorkspace autosaves the reply draft 800ms after a thread opens, before the server draft GET has resolved; the empty local body is treated as 'the user cleared the field' and a DELETE is sent. The draft is also marked saved before the server confirms, so a failed PUT is swallowed and never retried. Required: distinguish loading from a user edit, confirm only after the server acknowledges, surface the error and allow a retry. Acceptance: slow GET >800ms does not delete text; failed PUT stays visibly unsaved and is retryable; reload and fast thread switching preserve the last confirmed edit. Evidence in apps/web/src/workspaces/SupportClaimsWorkspace.tsx (draft effect ~L394-410, loadThreadDetail ~L521-551).
notes: LND-R4-01 fixed: reply-draft autosave moved into apps/web/src/workspaces/support-draft-autosave.ts (framework-agnostic state machine: loading|clean|dirty|saving|saved|error). Rules: no write at all before the draft GET settles (no DELETE while loading or after a failed load); a draft counts as saved only after the server confirms the write; a failed write keeps the text unsaved, reports the error via notify and can be retried; DELETE only when the operator cleared a text the client knows the server holds; a locally typed answer always wins over a late draft response. Workspace renders the status badge (Черновик сохранён / Не сохранено) plus a retry control. Tests: test/web/support-draft-autosave.test.ts (npx vitest run test/web/support-draft-autosave.test.ts) - not executed locally, the shared PostgreSQL port forbids vitest here.
close_reason: LND-R4-01 closed: draft autosave is a framework-agnostic state machine; nothing is written before the load settles, a failed load never deletes, saved means acknowledged, failures stay visible and retryable. Evidence: test/web/support-draft-autosave.test.ts (6), live check LND-R4-01-1.

title: LND-R5-02: draft cleanup and send are not serialised with an in-flight autosave PUT
description: Independent recheck of PR #4 (candidate 646a72f). After every write the controller must reconcile the current text with the confirmed server state instead of only cancelling the timer: clearing the box during a pending PUT leaves the box empty while the server still holds the old text (dirty without a further save), and a late PUT re-creates an already sent answer as a draft after the DELETE. Reconcile after each write and serialise the cleanup after the send.
acceptance_criteria: Clearing and restoring the previous text during a PUT ends in identical UI and server state; there is no dirty state without a further save. After a send with a pending PUT, waiting for all responses and reloading does not bring the sent answer back as a draft.
notes: LND-R5-02 fixed in apps/web/src/workspaces/support-draft-autosave.ts. Only one write per thread runs at a time; every write is followed by a reconciliation that compares the current box with the confirmed server state and issues the missing write (PUT or DELETE) right away. The send cleanup is serialised: dropDraft is set and the DELETE is requested immediately, but it can only start after the running write has finished, so a late PUT can no longer re-create the sent answer as a draft. openThread no longer copies a dropped (stale) draft into the box and does not reset the confirmed state while a write is running. Tests: test/web/support-draft-autosave.test.ts (new describe block, 7 cases).
close_reason: Every write is followed by a reconciliation of the box with the confirmed server state; the cleanup after a send is serialised behind the running write, so the sent answer cannot come back as a draft. Browser acceptance: LND-R5-UI-3.

title: Owner decision: lifecycle of the public laundry demo instance

WHY A PREVIEW PROFILE WAS NEEDED
The production build of this codebase has no working sign-in. With NODE_ENV=production and the
